name: A chain of 100,000, in order
expr: (lambda t: None if t is None else tree_cost(args[0], args[1], t))(mst(args[0], list(args[1])))
show: 0–1–2–…–99999, each line costing 1, listed in order
why: 99999. Each line joins the group holding 0, 1, …, i to the single station i + 1. If joining two groups means relabelling every station of the first group, that is 1 + 2 + … + 99,999: about 5 billion steps. Union-find joins two groups in one step (DSUF-2), and relabelling only the smaller group also works.
